_about: Hero skills. Power multiplies attack; ranges are in tiles; effects are statuses put on the target (name: turns). From the old game's SK table.

skills.name: Slash
skills.text: A quick sword cut.

skills.name: Rend
skills.text: A cut that makes the target bleed for 3 turns.

skills.name: Power Strike
skills.text: A heavy two-handed blow.

skills.name: Whirlwind
skills.text: Spin attack: hits the target and every enemy next to it.

skills.name: Crescent Wave
skills.text: Throws a blade of energy 2–3 tiles away.

skills.name: Shoulder Check
skills.text: Shoves the target 2 tiles back. If it slams into a wall or another unit it takes +50% and is stunned 1 turn.

skills.name: Execution
skills.text: Finishing blow: +50% damage on enemies under 40% HP.

skills.name: Riposte Stance
skills.text: Until your next turn, strike back at every enemy that hits you in melee (power 0.8).

skills.name: Leaping Cleave
skills.text: Leap up to 3 tiles to land next to the target, then hit it and every enemy next to you.

skills.name: Dragon Slash
skills.text: A blazing fire slash that leaves a 4-turn burn.

skills.name: Sunder
skills.text: Strips every buff and shield from the target.

skills.name: Battle Trance
skills.text: For 2 turns: +25% damage and +1 Move, but you take 15% more damage.

skills.name: Momentum
skills.text: If it defeats the target you may act once more this turn (once per turn).

skills.name: Bash
skills.text: A solid shield-and-axe hit.

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.text: Stuns the target for 1 turn.

skills.name: Crushing Blow
skills.text: Smashes armor: the target loses 30% DEF for 2 turns.

skills.name: Ground Pound
skills.text: Hits the target and its neighbors and snares them.

skills.name: Ironhide
skills.text: Brace: take 40% less damage until your next turn ends.

skills.name: Hook Chain
skills.text: Throw a chain 2-3 tiles and drag the target to the tile next to you.

skills.name: Bodyguard
skills.text: Pick an ally within 3 tiles. For 2 turns, hits aimed at them hit you instead, for 70% of the damage.

skills.name: Fortress Slam
skills.text: Shockwave that stuns everything within 2 tiles of the target.

skills.name: Iron Shell
skills.text: Gain a shield worth 25% of your max HP.

skills.name: Titan's Wrath
skills.text: Golden smash that stuns the target and its neighbors.

skills.name: Taunting Roar
skills.text: Every enemy within 3 tiles must attack you on its next turn.

skills.name: Aftershock
skills.text: Hits the target and its neighbors and snares them; at the start of the next enemy turn the ground shakes again for half damage.

skills.name: Unstoppable
skills.text: Bulldoze up to 4 tiles in a straight line. Every enemy in the way is hit and shoved to the side.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.text: Fire magic. Ignores half of armor.

skills.name: Frost Bolt
skills.text: Ice magic that snares for 1 turn.

skills.name: Meteor
skills.text: Calls a flaming rock down on an area.

skills.name: Thunder
skills.text: Thunder magic. Ignores half of armor.

skills.name: Ice Lance
skills.text: A long-range spear of ice.

skills.name: Chain Lightning
skills.text: Lightning jumps to every enemy next to the target.

skills.name: Blizzard
skills.text: Snowstorm on an area that snares everything hit.

skills.name: Blink
skills.text: Teleport to an open tile up to 4 away. You can still attack this turn.

skills.name: Mana Burn
skills.text: Arcane hit that adds 1 turn to every cooldown the target has.

skills.name: Arcane Nova
skills.text: Pure arcane blast hitting everything within 2 tiles.

skills.name: Static Field
skills.text: Lightning within 2 tiles of the target; those tiles stay charged for 2 turns and shock any enemy that ends its turn on them.

skills.name: Gravity Well
skills.text: Arcane hit on an area that pulls every enemy within 2 tiles one step toward the center.

skills.name: Echo
skills.text: Cast the last spell you used again at 60% power on a new target, without starting its cooldown.

skills.name: Heal Ally
skills.text: Heals one ally up to 3 tiles away.

skills.name: Mend Self
skills.text: Heals yourself.

skills.name: Divine Grace
skills.text: Huge heal anywhere on the map, but you cannot move for 2 turns.

skills.name: Radiant Burst
skills.text: Holy light damage. Strong against dark enemies.

skills.name: Blessing
skills.text: You and allies within 4 tiles deal 25% more damage for 2 turns.

skills.name: Cleanse
skills.text: Removes bleed, snare, stun and armor break.

skills.name: Holy Siphon
skills.text: Light damage, then heals your most hurt ally for 100% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Mass Heal
skills.text: Heals the target and every ally within 2 tiles of it.

skills.name: Prism Aura
skills.text: You and allies within 4 tiles ignore enemy typing: every hit lands with advantage (×1.5) for 2 turns.

skills.name: Last Light
skills.text: You and allies within 3 tiles are healed 30% and, for 2 turns, a blow that would defeat them leaves them at 1 HP instead.

skills.name: Sacred Flame
skills.text: Holy fire on the target and enemies next to it.

skills.name: Resurrection
skills.text: Revives the most recently fallen ally next to you at 40% HP. Once per battle.

skills.name: Renewal
skills.text: You and allies within 4 tiles regenerate 12% HP at the start of each turn for 3 turns.

skills.name: Shot
skills.text: A standard arrow. Cannot hit adjacent enemies.

skills.name: Snaring Shot
skills.text: Snares the target for 1 turn.

skills.name: Power Shot
skills.text: A fully drawn heavy arrow.

skills.name: Multishot
skills.text: Three arrows: hits the target and enemies next to it.

skills.name: Poison Arrow
skills.text: Poisons the target for 4 turns.

skills.name: Pinning Shot
skills.text: Pins the target in place: stun 1 turn.

skills.name: Piercing Shot
skills.text: Passes through and hits the next 2 tiles behind the target.

skills.name: Steady Aim
skills.text: Stand still this turn: your next shot gets +2 range and cannot miss.

skills.name: Disengage
skills.text: Shoot, then leap 2 tiles directly away from the target.

skills.name: Rain of Arrows
skills.text: Arrows rain on everything within 2 tiles of the target.

skills.name: Hunter's Mark
skills.text: Marks the target for 3 turns: everyone on your side deals it +20% damage.

skills.name: Concussive Arrow
skills.text: Knocks the target 2 tiles back.

skills.name: Flaming Volley
skills.text: Fire arrows on the target and its neighbors; the ground burns for 2 turns.

skills.name: Blood Rage
skills.text: A frenzied blow that heals you for 30% of the damage.

skills.name: Holy Judgment
skills.text: Holy strike. Heals adjacent allies 20% of their max HP.

skills.name: Thousand Cuts
skills.text: Five lightning-fast slashes.

skills.name: Earthshatter
skills.text: Splits the ground: stuns everything within 2 tiles.

skills.name: Bulwark
skills.text: You and allies within 3 tiles take 40% less damage.

skills.name: War Cry
skills.text: You and allies within 4 tiles deal 25% more damage.

skills.name: Inferno
skills.text: A sea of fire over a wide area.

skills.name: Absolute Zero
skills.text: Freezes a wide area solid: stun 1 turn.

skills.name: Thunderstorm
skills.text: Lightning strikes up to 4 enemies in range.

skills.name: Sanctuary
skills.text: Heals every ally on the map.

skills.name: Time Warp
skills.text: Allies within 4 tiles get Haste and their cooldowns reset.

skills.name: Pandemic
skills.text: A plague cloud: dark damage and bleed 4 in a wide area.

skills.name: Deadeye
skills.text: A perfect shot from up to 12 tiles. Ignores all DEF.

skills.name: Snare Field
skills.text: Traps everything within 2 tiles of the target.

skills.name: Gale Volley
skills.text: Storm arrows hit up to 3 enemies in range.

skills.name: Stab
skills.text: A quick dagger strike.

skills.name: Venom Edge
skills.text: Poisoned blade: bleed 3 turns.

skills.name: Assassinate
skills.text: A killing strike: +50% damage on enemies under 40% HP.

skills.name: Ambush
skills.text: +50% damage against enemies at full HP.

skills.name: Fan of Knives
skills.text: Knives hit the target and every enemy next to it.

skills.name: Shadowstep
skills.text: Teleport to the far side of an enemy within 4 tiles and stab it in the back.

skills.name: Smoke Bomb
skills.text: Vanish in smoke: 40% less damage taken and +2 Move for 2 turns.

skills.name: Garrote
skills.text: Silences the target for 2 turns: it can only use its most basic attack.

skills.name: Bait and Switch
skills.text: Swap places with any unit, friend or foe, within 3 tiles.

skills.name: Death Blossom
skills.text: Four spinning slashes that also hit enemies next to the target.

skills.name: Crippling Cut
skills.text: Target bleeds 2 turns and loses 2 Move for 2 turns.

skills.name: Open Veins
skills.text: Every bleed and poison on the target ticks right now, and their turns left double.

skills.name: Twin Fangs
skills.text: Strike two different enemies next to you.

skills.name: Quick Shot
skills.text: A fast pistol shot. Cannot hit adjacent enemies.

skills.name: Double Tap
skills.text: Two quick shots at one target.

skills.name: Hollow Point
skills.text: Heavy round that breaks armor (−30% DEF) for 2 turns.

skills.name: Ricochet
skills.text: The bullet bounces to a second enemy in range.

skills.name: Flash Bang
skills.text: Stuns the target for 1 turn.

skills.name: Scatter Shot
skills.text: Shotgun blast on the target and enemies next to it. Works up close.

skills.name: Boot Shot
skills.text: Kick an enemy next to you 2 tiles away and fire as it flies.

skills.name: Disarming Shot
skills.text: Shoots the weapon hand: target deals 30% less damage for 2 turns.

skills.name: Roll Out
skills.text: Dive-roll up to 3 tiles, then shoot.

skills.name: Bullet Hell
skills.text: Unload on up to 6 enemies in range.

skills.name: Powder Keg
skills.text: Toss a keg on a tile up to 4 away. It blows up at the start of the next enemy turn: fire on everything within 1 tile.

skills.name: Lucky Coin
skills.text: Your next 2 shots are sure critical hits.

skills.name: High Noon
skills.text: +10% damage for every enemy in your range (max +60%).

skills.name: Spear Thrust
skills.text: A spear thrust from dragonback.

skills.name: Dragon Claw
skills.text: The dragon rakes the target: bleed 2.

skills.name: Impale
skills.text: A lance thrust that pierces 1 tile behind the target.

skills.name: Dragonfire
skills.text: The dragon breathes fire on an area.

skills.name: Wing Gust
skills.text: A blast of wind that snares the target and its neighbors.

skills.name: Sky Dive
skills.text: Dive from the sky onto a target 2–4 tiles away.

skills.name: Tail Sweep
skills.text: Hits every enemy next to you and shoves each 1 tile away.

skills.name: Dragon Scales
skills.text: For 2 turns take 30% less spell damage and reflect 20% of melee damage back.

skills.name: Wyrm Roar
skills.text: Enemies within 2 tiles are pushed 1 tile away and deal 30% less damage for 2 turns.

skills.name: Dragon's Fury
skills.text: A firestorm on everything within 2 tiles of the target.

skills.name: Ember Trail
skills.text: Fly up to 4 tiles in a line; every tile you pass over burns for 2 turns.

skills.name: Skewer
skills.text: Lance a target 2 tiles away and drag it next to you.

skills.name: Wyrmbond
skills.text: For 3 turns your dragon claws an enemy next to you at the end of each of your turns (power 0.9).

skills.name: Phantom Rush
skills.text: Blink between up to 4 enemies in range, striking each.

skills.name: Venom Storm
skills.text: A toxic cloud: bleed 5 on everything within 2 tiles.

skills.name: Crimson Waltz
skills.text: Five dancing slashes on one target.

skills.name: Six Shooter
skills.text: Empties the cylinder into one target.

skills.name: Dead or Alive
skills.text: A bounty shot: +50% on enemies under 40% HP.

skills.name: Ricochet Storm
skills.text: Bullets bounce between up to 5 enemies.

skills.name: Soul Nova
skills.text: An explosion of souls that heals you for 20% of the damage.

skills.name: Blood Moon
skills.text: Costs 20% HP: a crimson blast within 2 tiles.

skills.name: Hellfire Dive
skills.text: A flaming dive bomb on an area.

skills.name: Glacial Breath
skills.text: Freezing breath that stuns.

skills.name: Thunder Lance
skills.text: A lightning lance that pierces 3 tiles behind the target.

skills.name: Toxic Bolt
skills.text: Dark magic that poisons for 2 turns.

skills.name: Hex
skills.text: Weakens the target: it deals 30% less damage and loses 30% DEF for 2 turns.

skills.name: Witch's Brew
skills.text: A boiling brew: poison and weakness on an area.

skills.name: Miasma
skills.text: A poison cloud on the target and enemies next to it.

skills.name: Curse of Frailty
skills.text: A long curse: −30% DEF and −30% damage for 3 turns.

skills.name: Plague Swarm
skills.text: Poison insects attack up to 3 enemies in range.

skills.name: Voodoo Link
skills.text: Bind two enemies in range for 3 turns: half of any damage one takes also hits the other.

skills.name: Wither
skills.text: For 3 turns the target heals only half and can't gain buffs.

skills.name: Puppet Strings
skills.text: Move an enemy within 4 tiles up to 2 tiles wherever you choose.

skills.name: Hex Storm
skills.text: A storm of curses within 2 tiles: poison 4 and armor break.

skills.name: Soul Siphon
skills.text: Dark hit that heals you for half the damage.

skills.name: Contagion
skills.text: Copies every curse and poison on the target onto enemies within 2 tiles of it.

skills.name: Bog of Despair
skills.text: A swamp 1 tile around a spot for 3 turns: enemies inside are snared and poisoned.

skills.name: Lance Strike
skills.text: A heavy mounted lance hit.

skills.name: Charge
skills.text: +12% damage for every tile you moved this turn (max +60%).

skills.name: Grand Charge
skills.text: An all-out charge. Gains charge damage.

skills.name: Lance Break
skills.text: Breaks armor: −30% DEF for 2 turns.

skills.name: Running Thrust
skills.text: A charging thrust from up to 2 tiles away. Gains charge damage.

skills.name: Valor
skills.text: Steel yourself: +25% damage and 40% less damage taken for 2 turns.

skills.name: Trample
skills.text: Ride straight through up to 3 tiles of enemies to an open tile, hitting each one.

skills.name: Shield of Faith
skills.text: Give an ally within 3 tiles a shield worth 20% of your max HP.

skills.name: Unhorse
skills.text: Knocks the target 1 tile back and it can't move next turn.

skills.name: Cavalry Breaker
skills.text: A devastating single-target charge.

skills.name: Lance Wall
skills.text: Until your next turn, any enemy that steps next to you is struck first (power 0.9).

skills.name: Rescue
skills.text: Pull an ally within 4 tiles to a tile next to you; they take 20% less damage for 1 turn.

skills.name: Relentless Charge
skills.text: A charge (charge damage); afterwards you may keep moving with the Move you have left.

skills.name: Grand Hex
skills.text: Curses everything within 2 tiles: weak, armor break and snare.

skills.name: Crusade
skills.text: A holy charge that heals allies next to you 20%.

skills.name: Doom Lance
skills.text: A crushing single-target lance from up to 2 tiles.

skills.name: Lightning Charge
skills.text: A lightning-fast charge. Gains charge damage.

skills.name: Cloak
skills.text: Turn invisible: enemies can't target you for 2 enemy turns. Attacking breaks the cloak. After it ends, Cloak recharges for 2 turns.

skills.name: Strike
skills.text: A basic attack with your selected weapon set. Melee weapons hit 1 tile, bows and guns 2–6, staffs and wands 2–6 as magic.
